title: Sydney United at the VAL Elite Championship in Xiamen
excerpt: Volleyball Club Sydney United is in Xiamen, China, for the VAL Volleyball Elite Championship from 1 to 6 October 2026, with ProSporter supporting the team.

image.altText: Sydney United players in front of the VAL Volleyball Elite Championship Xiamen backdrop

contentHtml:
Volleyball Club Sydney United has travelled to Xiamen, China, for the VAL Volleyball Elite Championship. The championship is presented by VAL, the Volleyball Amateur League, and runs from 1 to 6 October 2026.

ProSporter is proud to support the team on this trip. The squad is wearing navy ProSporter kit in Xiamen, and it is great to see our colours on court so far from home.

Tournaments and tours like this are what our teamwear is made for. Good luck to the whole Sydney United squad.
